data.body:
AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F1, F2, F3 + gap-analysis #2, #3):

**Plan-review F1 critical correction**: Do NOT reuse parse_test_index() — it STRIPS markers and returns bare paths (the opposite of what we need). Instead, scan .test-index lines directly with regex for the marker pattern. Reference the marker-detection logic in plugins/dso/scripts/runners/bash-runner.sh:_RED_MARKER_MAP as the canonical grammar source.

**Plan-review F2**: Drop the git<2.38 fallback path entirely. GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest ships git 2.43+. The fallback (git merge --no-commit) would mutate the working tree — dangerous in CI. Add a preflight 'git --version' check that fails loud if git<2.38.

**Plan-review F3 + gap-analysis #3 race-safety**: Script MUST accept BASE SHA and HEAD SHA as positional args (or required env vars BASE_SHA, HEAD_SHA). Script MUST NOT internally resolve refs via git rev-parse. Always run 'git merge-tree --write-tree BASE_SHA HEAD_SHA' with the supplied SHAs.

**Plan-review F3 conflict-marker handling**: If git show <tree-sha>:.test-index returns content containing conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>), the script must exit non-zero with 'cannot scan .test-index: merge conflicts present' rather than silently misparsing.

**Gap-analysis #2 grammar parity**: scan-red-markers.sh MUST recognize exactly the same RED marker grammar that parse_test_index() recognizes. The README/REVIEW-DEFENSE comment block at top of .test-index is the authoritative grammar source. Validation via parity test (T7).

Additional AC items:
- [ ] Script accepts BASE_SHA and HEAD_SHA as positional args; rejects invocation without explicit SHAs
  Verify: grep -qE 'BASE_SHA|positional|\$1.*\$2' plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh
- [ ] Script does NOT call git rev-parse on a branch name (only on SHAs)
  Verify: ! grep -E 'git rev-parse.*HEAD|git rev-parse.*main|git rev-parse.*session' plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh
- [ ] Script handles conflict markers in .test-index content
  Verify: grep -qE '<<<<<<<|conflict' plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh
- [ ] No git<2.38 fallback path
  Verify: ! grep -E 'git merge --no-commit|fallback.*git' plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh
- [ ] Header preflight git version check
  Verify: grep -qE 'git --version|2\.38' plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh
